title: Which Constitutional Amendment is known as the First Amendment Act of 1951?
description: The First Constitutional Amendment made several important changes to fundamental rights and land reform provisions.
hint: It was enacted soon after the Constitution came into force.
summary: The Constitution (First Amendment) Act, 1951 introduced provisions including Articles 31A and 31B and the Ninth Schedule.

title: Which Constitutional Amendment reorganized states primarily on linguistic lines?
description: The reorganization of states in the 1950s resulted in major changes to the territorial structure of India.
summary: The Seventh Amendment Act, 1956 facilitated the reorganization of states and abolished the earlier classification of states into Part A, B, C and D categories.

title: The Ninth Schedule was added to the Constitution by which amendment?
description: The Ninth Schedule was created to provide constitutional protection to certain laws, especially land reform laws.
hint: It was one of the major provisions of the first amendment.
summary: The Ninth Schedule was introduced by the First Constitutional Amendment Act, 1951.

title: Which amendment facilitated the incorporation of Goa into India as a state?
description: Goa became part of India in 1961 and was subsequently made a state through a constitutional amendment.
summary: The Fifty-sixth Amendment Act, 1987 made special constitutional provisions connected with Goa's transition to statehood.

title: Which amendment lowered the voting age from 21 years to 18 years?
description: The voting age for elections to the Lok Sabha and state legislative assemblies was reduced in 1988.
hint: It is commonly associated with the number 61.
summary: The Sixty-first Amendment Act, 1988 lowered the voting age from 21 to 18 years.

title: Which amendment is popularly known as the 'Mini Constitution'?
description: One amendment made extensive changes to many parts of the Constitution during the Emergency period.
summary: The Forty-second Amendment Act, 1976 is popularly known as the Mini Constitution because of its extensive changes.

title: Which amendment added the words 'Socialist', 'Secular' and 'Integrity' to the Preamble?
description: The Preamble was amended during the Emergency period.
summary: The Forty-second Amendment Act, 1976 added the words Socialist, Secular and Integrity to the Preamble.

title: Which amendment restored the normal constitutional position after several changes made during the Emergency?
description: The amendment enacted in 1978 sought to reverse several provisions of the Forty-second Amendment.
hint: It followed the end of the Emergency.
summary: The Forty-fourth Amendment Act, 1978 reversed or modified several Emergency-era changes and introduced important safeguards.

title: Which amendment removed the Right to Property from the list of Fundamental Rights?
description: The constitutional status of property rights was changed in 1978.
summary: The Forty-fourth Amendment removed Article 31 from Fundamental Rights and inserted Article 300A, making property a constitutional legal right.

title: Which amendment introduced the Anti-Defection Law?
description: The Anti-Defection Law was added to the Constitution to discourage elected representatives from changing parties under certain circumstances.
summary: The Fifty-second Amendment Act, 1985 introduced the Tenth Schedule, commonly known as the Anti-Defection Law.

title: The Tenth Schedule was added to the Constitution by which amendment?
description: The Tenth Schedule contains provisions relating to disqualification on grounds of defection.
hint: It was part of the Anti-Defection Law.
summary: The Fifty-second Amendment Act, 1985 added the Tenth Schedule.

title: Which amendment provided constitutional status to Panchayati Raj Institutions?
description: The constitutional framework for rural local self-government was introduced in the early 1990s.
summary: The Seventy-third Amendment Act, 1992 gave constitutional status to Panchayats and added Part IX.

title: Which amendment provided constitutional status to Urban Local Bodies?
description: Municipalities received constitutional recognition through an amendment enacted alongside the Panchayati Raj reforms.
summary: The Seventy-fourth Amendment Act, 1992 provided constitutional status to municipalities and added Part IXA.

title: Which amendment added the Eleventh Schedule to the Constitution?
description: The Eleventh Schedule contains subjects that may be devolved to Panchayats.
hint: It is associated with Panchayati Raj.
summary: The Seventy-third Amendment Act, 1992 added the Eleventh Schedule containing 29 subjects.

title: Which amendment added the Twelfth Schedule to the Constitution?
description: The Twelfth Schedule lists functions that may be assigned to municipalities.
hint: It is associated with urban local government.
summary: The Seventy-fourth Amendment Act, 1992 added the Twelfth Schedule containing 18 subjects.

title: Which amendment inserted Article 21A providing for the Right to Education?
description: The Constitution was amended to make education a Fundamental Right for children in a specified age group.
summary: The Eighty-sixth Amendment Act, 2002 inserted Article 21A, providing free and compulsory education for children aged 6 to 14 years.

title: Which amendment limited the size of the Council of Ministers to 15% of the strength of the Lok Sabha or state assembly?
description: The amendment was intended to curb the expansion of ministries and strengthen the Anti-Defection framework.
summary: The Ninety-first Amendment Act, 2003 capped the size of the Council of Ministers at 15% of the respective legislature's strength.

title: Which amendment gave constitutional status to cooperative societies?
description: The amendment introduced constitutional provisions concerning cooperative societies.
summary: The Ninety-seventh Amendment Act, 2011 added provisions relating to cooperative societies, including Part IXB.

title: Which amendment provided for the formation of the Goods and Services Tax Council?
description: The constitutional framework for GST was introduced through a major amendment.
summary: The One Hundred and First Amendment Act, 2016 introduced the constitutional framework for GST and Article 279A establishing the GST Council.

title: Which amendment gave constitutional status to the National Commission for Backward Classes?
description: The amendment inserted provisions concerning the National Commission for Backward Classes.
summary: The One Hundred and Second Amendment Act, 2018 gave constitutional status to the National Commission for Backward Classes and inserted Article 338B.

title: Which amendment introduced a 10% reservation for Economically Weaker Sections?
description: A constitutional amendment enabled special provisions for economically weaker sections in education and public employment.
summary: The One Hundred and Third Amendment Act, 2019 enabled up to 10% reservation for Economically Weaker Sections.

title: Which amendment extended the reservation of seats for SCs and STs in the Lok Sabha and state assemblies for ten years from 2020?
description: The amendment extended the period of political reservation for Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes.
summary: The One Hundred and Fourth Amendment Act, 2019 extended SC/ST political reservation for ten years, while ending the nominated Anglo-Indian representation provision.

title: Which amendment restored the power of states to identify socially and educationally backward classes for their own purposes?
description: The amendment addressed the distribution of powers concerning identification of backward classes.
hint: It followed the Supreme Court's interpretation concerning the 102nd Amendment.
summary: The One Hundred and Fifth Amendment Act, 2021 restored states' power to identify socially and educationally backward classes for state purposes.

title: The Constitution (One Hundred and Sixth Amendment) Act, 2023 is popularly associated with which initiative?
description: The amendment provides for reservation of seats for women in specified legislative bodies.
hint: It is commonly known as the Nari Shakti Vandan Adhiniyam.
summary: The 106th Amendment Act, 2023 provides for reservation of seats for women in the Lok Sabha, state legislative assemblies and the Delhi Legislative Assembly, subject to its constitutional conditions.

title: Which article primarily prescribes the procedure for amendment of the Constitution?
description: The Constitution contains a specific article dealing with constitutional amendment procedures.
summary: Article 368 of the Constitution deals with the power and procedure of Parliament to amend the Constitution.

title: Which amendment made it clear that Parliament can amend Fundamental Rights?
description: The constitutional amendment power of Parliament was clarified through an amendment following judicial developments.
summary: The Twenty-fourth Amendment Act, 1971 affirmed Parliament's power to amend any part of the Constitution, including Fundamental Rights.

title: Which amendment curtailed the Fundamental Right to Property and strengthened the protection of certain Directive Principles?
description: The amendment was part of the constitutional changes made during the early 1970s.
summary: The Twenty-fifth Amendment Act, 1971 inserted Article 31C and changed the constitutional position concerning property rights.

title: Which amendment abolished privy purses and privileges of former princely rulers?
description: The constitutional recognition and privileges of former rulers were abolished in 1971.
summary: The Twenty-sixth Amendment Act, 1971 abolished privy purses and official recognition of former rulers.

title: Which amendment made Sikkim a full-fledged state of India?
description: Sikkim's constitutional relationship with India changed significantly in the 1970s.
summary: The Thirty-sixth Amendment Act, 1975 made Sikkim a full-fledged state and added it as the 22nd state of India.

title: Which amendment was associated with the emergency-era changes that expanded the Centre's powers and made extensive constitutional changes?
description: This amendment made one of the largest sets of changes to the Constitution.
hint: It is popularly called the Mini Constitution.
summary: The Forty-second Amendment Act, 1976 made extensive changes to the Constitution.

title: Which amendment restored the jurisdiction of courts that had been curtailed by the Forty-second Amendment?
description: The amendment enacted in 1977 reversed several Emergency-era constitutional changes.
summary: The Forty-third Amendment Act, 1977 repealed several provisions inserted by the Forty-second Amendment and restored judicial powers.

title: Which amendment extended reservation of seats for SCs and STs in legislatures from the original constitutional period?
description: The constitutional reservation for SCs and STs in legislatures has been extended several times.
hint: The first such extension was made by the Eighth Amendment.
summary: The Eighth Amendment Act, 1959 extended reservation of seats for SCs and STs and Anglo-Indian representation for a further period.

title: Which amendment increased the period of reservation of seats for SCs and STs from 20 to 30 years?
description: The amendment extended the political reservation period provided by the Constitution.
summary: The Twenty-third Amendment Act, 1969 extended the reservation period for SCs and STs in legislatures to 30 years from the commencement of the Constitution.

title: Which amendment inserted Article 239AA relating to the National Capital Territory of Delhi?
description: Delhi received a special constitutional administrative framework through an amendment in 1991.
summary: The Sixty-ninth Amendment Act, 1991 inserted Article 239AA and provided for a Legislative Assembly and Council of Ministers for Delhi.

title: Which amendment made Konkani, Manipuri and Nepali languages part of the Eighth Schedule?
description: Three languages were added to the list of constitutionally recognized scheduled languages in 1992.
summary: The Seventy-first Amendment Act, 1992 added Konkani, Manipuri and Nepali to the Eighth Schedule.

title: Which amendment added Bodo, Dogri, Maithili and Santhali to the Eighth Schedule?
description: Four additional languages were added to the Constitution's Eighth Schedule in 2003.
summary: The Ninety-second Amendment Act, 2003 added Bodo, Dogri, Maithili and Santhali to the Eighth Schedule.

title: Which amendment changed the constitutional provisions relating to reservation in promotions for SCs and STs?
description: The amendment specifically addressed reservation in promotion for certain communities.
summary: The Seventy-seventh Amendment Act, 1995 enabled reservation in promotions for SCs and STs through Article 16(4A).

title: Which amendment inserted Article 16(4B) concerning unfilled reserved vacancies?
description: The amendment enabled certain unfilled reserved vacancies to be treated separately for future recruitment.
summary: The Eighty-first Amendment Act, 2000 inserted Article 16(4B) concerning the carrying forward of unfilled reserved vacancies.

title: Which amendment enabled reservation in promotion for SCs and STs with consequential seniority?
description: The amendment modified Article 16 in relation to reservation in promotions.
summary: The Eighty-fifth Amendment Act, 2001 provided for consequential seniority in promotions for SCs and STs with reservation.

title: Which amendment enabled reservation for socially and educationally backward classes in educational institutions, including private institutions other than minority institutions?
description: The amendment inserted a constitutional provision dealing with special provisions for admission to educational institutions.
summary: The Ninety-third Amendment Act, 2005 inserted Article 15(5), enabling special provisions for socially and educationally backward classes and SCs and STs in educational institutions.

title: Which amendment converted the National Commission for Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes into separate commissions?
description: The constitutional framework for SCs and STs was separated into two commissions.
summary: The Eighty-ninth Amendment Act, 2003 provided for separate National Commissions for Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes.

title: Which amendment removed the provision that required the President to appoint an Anglo-Indian member to the Lok Sabha after 2020?
description: The constitutional provision for nominated Anglo-Indian representation was allowed to expire through an amendment.
summary: The One Hundred and Fourth Amendment Act, 2019 ended the constitutional provision for nominated Anglo-Indian members in the Lok Sabha and state assemblies while extending SC/ST reservation.

title: Which amendment was related to the inclusion of Berubari Union territory through an agreement with Pakistan?
description: A constitutional amendment was required to implement the transfer of certain territories under the Indo-Pak agreement.
summary: The Ninth Amendment Act, 1960 gave effect to the transfer of certain territories between India and Pakistan under the Indo-Pak agreement.

title: Which amendment incorporated Dadra and Nagar Haveli into the Union of India?
description: The constitutional status of Dadra and Nagar Haveli was changed through an amendment in 1961.
summary: The Tenth Amendment Act, 1961 incorporated Dadra and Nagar Haveli into India as a Union Territory.

title: Which amendment incorporated Goa, Daman and Diu into India as Union Territories?
description: Following the end of Portuguese rule, these territories were constitutionally incorporated into India.
summary: The Twelfth Amendment Act, 1962 incorporated Goa, Daman and Diu into the Union of India as Union Territories.

title: Which amendment included Puducherry in the Union of India?
description: The former French establishments were constitutionally integrated into India.
summary: The Fourteenth Amendment Act, 1962 incorporated Puducherry into India and provided for representation of certain Union Territories.

title: Which amendment inserted the words 'sovereignty and integrity of India' into the oath and enabled restrictions concerning secessionist activities?
description: The amendment introduced changes concerning allegiance to India's sovereignty and integrity.
summary: The Sixteenth Amendment Act, 1963 amended the forms of oath and enabled restrictions in the interests of India's sovereignty and integrity.

title: Which amendment transferred certain territories between India and Pakistan following the 1974 agreement?
description: The constitutional amendment implemented the India-Bangladesh Land Boundary Agreement and its protocol.
summary: The One Hundredth Amendment Act, 2015 gave effect to the India-Bangladesh Land Boundary Agreement and related territorial exchanges.

title: Which amendment introduced the National Judicial Appointments Commission?
description: The amendment sought to replace the collegium system with a constitutional commission for judicial appointments.
hint: The Supreme Court later struck down the amendment.
summary: The Ninety-ninth Amendment Act, 2014 created the National Judicial Appointments Commission, but the Supreme Court declared the amendment unconstitutional in 2015.

title: Which amendment is associated with the reservation of seats for women in the Lok Sabha and State Legislative Assemblies?
description: The amendment provides for reservation of seats for women in specified legislative bodies.
hint: It is the most recent constitutional amendment in this batch.
summary: The One Hundred and Sixth Amendment Act, 2023 provides for reservation of approximately one-third of seats for women in the Lok Sabha, State Legislative Assemblies and the Delhi Legislative Assembly, subject to the constitutional provisions concerning commencement and delimitation.
